items.title: Lillie Delk Christian Interview, 1961-04-25
items.q: Marlo Nichols, and he was your accompanist, huh?

ctx.x: That was a piano player. Oh, yeah. Uh-huh. He was a staff fellow, Marlo Nichols. He was a piano player with this white orchestra.
Mm-hmm. Marlo Nichols, and he was your accompanist, huh?

Mm-hmm. And at the whole orchestra, the whole orchestra was. At the Continental Club. The whole orchestra. Yeah. I don't remember. Was he around Chicago at all? No. I don't remember his name. No. No. No. No. He wasn't. His home is in the house.
